_comment: Integrity lockfile for the Bare Kit prebuilds (issue #55). scripts/fetch-prebuilds.mjs reads everything from here: `repo`, `version` (the pinned upstream release; a CLI version argument must equal it), and per release asset its `sha256` and the archive paths to `extract`. The script fails closed on a missing or mismatched hash and on absolute, `..` or symlink entries, and replaces prebuilds/<dir> wholesale. When bumping bare-kit, record the new hash only after checking it against the upstream release; never commit a placeholder hash. `spm` pins the BareKit.xcframework.zip that the root Package.swift `.binaryTarget` resolves: a zip of ios/BareKit.xcframework from this bare-kit version, hosted as an asset of the ekrooh release named in `url` (for v2.5.5 that is the v0.6.0 release; later bumps host it on a `bare-kit-<version>` release, see RELEASING.md). It changes only when bare-kit is bumped. security.test.ts keeps Package.swift in sync with it, and the CI `ios` job checks the zip's contents equal the hash-verified prebuild (.github/scripts/verify-spm-binary.mjs).
